description: A list of foods checked against ACOG, FDA, and WHO guidelines. That's the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists, the Food and Drug Administration, and the World Health Organization.
whatThisIs: This CheckPregnancy feature lists foods and their risk levels during pregnancy, based on guidance from at least one of the following organizations: the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists, the Food and Drug Administration, and the World Health Organization.
whoItHelps: Parents and families who want to quickly check the risk level of certain foods using guidance from the organizations listed above
People who are pregnant and want simpler explanations of why certain foods are categorized as risky in larger amounts
whatToKnow: While helpful, this website should not replace the advice of a medical professional. It uses information from trusted sites to categorize foods and is separate from those sites. If you're concerned about the accuracy of a food profile, ask your health care professional or consult the website of the organization cited in that profile.
name: CheckPregnancy - Foods
